messages:
maria-g: Quick pulse — ran a 5% canary of int4-v2 against prod baseline (v2p1). Snapshot: MRR -1.7% (stat sig), latency p95 -28ms, tokens/sec +10%. Dashboard: https://r.infra/dash/abc123 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
cheng-wang: can you share the slice breakdown? any obvious cohorts driving the MRR dip?
maria-g: top slices: long-doc summaries (>=2k tokens) -3.6% MRR, creative prompts -0.9%, code-completion neutral. Hallucination metric (fact-precision) up +0.4 percentage points on long-docs. Sampled pairs: https://r.infra/samples/tilt-1791234560
samir: hmm could be quantization noise on attention for long contexts. Did we warm KV cache properly?
lisa: KV hit rate looks fine in traces; p50 kv-warm latency is same. The error traces point to token-level probability shifts for rare tokens.
maria-g: also saw rerank pass-rate drop 0.8pp on the same slice. Not huge but consistent across two runs.
cheng-wang: what's our current auto-fallback rule? last I saw it was pretty coarse.
maria-g: current rule (prod):
```
if delta_mrr <= -0.01 and p.value < 0.05: auto_fallback=True
else: continue_rollout
```
This triggered once in an unrelated canary last month and rolled back.
samir: that rule is too blunt for long-docs where variance is higher. Suggest adding slice-weighting + relative thresholds and a hysteresis window. e.g.:
```
for slice in watchlist:
  if delta_mrr_rel(slice) <= -0.015 and n_requests(slice) > 500: mark_bad(slice)
if weighted_bad_score >= 0.6: auto_fallback
```
Also require 30m stable period before auto-fallback flips.
maria-g: proposal: hold promotion. Tighten auto-fallback to absolute delta -0.007 OR relative -1.2% over 30m with weighted-slice aggregation, and require p95 CI non-overlap.
cheng-wang: +1 to holding. We should also run an int8 cross-check to see if it's quantization-specific; if int8 matches baseline then maybe int4 too aggressive for long docs.
lisa: can we add an online compare that routes 1% to int8, 1% to int4, rest baseline? keep paired-by-user to reduce noise.
maria-g: yes, I'll patch the routing config and smoke both for 6h. Also will add a metric alert: "longdoc_mrr_delta" >= 0.007 triggers pager and auto-fallback flag.
deploy-bot: Canary updated: routing split -> baseline 98%, int8 1%, int4 1% for 6h (initiated by maria-g).
samir: one more: add a manual gate that blocks any >10% traffic bump until weighted_bad_score < 0.2 for 24h.
maria-g: noted. I'll update the rollout doc and call a quick sync if the pager trips. Thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: short thread about AB canary metrics and tightening auto-fallback rules for quantized model onboard. contains links and a code snippet for rule examples.
